dataset.description: The dataset, as its rules name it.

description.description: What the dataset holds, for whoever reads its rules.

fields.description: Field → where it comes from and what it is.

from.description:
Where an extraction reads it: a source by name and its table
(decision 0036).

key.description: The fields that identify a record.

source.description: The source's extract the dataset reads (its bronze table).

active_values.description:
On the field holding the `active` role, the values that make a
record active, compared trimmed and in upper case (decision 0058).

description.description: What the field holds: the dataset's documentation, field by field.

expires.description:
Its value loses validity over time (contact, income): timeliness
counts in its ICD (decision 0057).

priority.description: How much the field weighs in a record's ICD (decision 0057).

roles.description:
What the field is for in the charts (decision 0031): proposed by the
map job, confirmed by a steward with the mapping.

FieldRole.description: A field's role, which switches charts on (decision 0031).

oneOf.description: Part of the key of the entity the dataset describes (decision 0022).
A grouping dimension: office, advisor, product, channel.
The segment: client type, loan type. One field.
The date of the last update. One field, a date.
The amount outliers are sought in. One field, a number.
A variable whose drift between cuts is measured; a number.
Takes part in the SFC indicator: a cell (decision 0058).

Says whether a record is active, by its `active_values`: the SFC
indicator's population. One field, text.

Kind.description: The field's type in silver: what its values are compared as.

oneOf.description: Codes are text, so their leading zeros survive (decision 0033).

Priority.description: A field's priority: its weight in a record's ICD (decision 0057).

oneOf.description: Until a steward sets one: every field weighs the same.

ReadFrom.description: A source's table, as an extraction reads it.

table.description:
`table`, `schema.table` or `database.schema.table`, as the source
names it.

Semantic.description: What the values mean, inferred by the map job and confirmed by people.
